address: 2F, VIBES OF NATURE 33/66, Mu 1, Muang Chao Fah Road, Kathu, Phuket, 83120, Thailand
bio: Set on the second floor of a modern building, this restaurant puts a delicious contemporary spin on classic Swiss cuisine. Expect balanced, well structured and cleanly presented Alpine dishes, such as house-made sausages, potato rösti and fondue-inspired specialities. Meat and cheese are central; the desserts, too, are carefully composed. To truly appreciate the narrative behind the cuisine, opt for the full experience menu.
